items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And I was playing at the time with Mike Crotty’s band, Mike’s a very good arranger, who writes for the Air Force band, so we did a concert at the Smithsonian, we got David Allyn to come in, we got Mel Lewis to come in…
